Subject: POC: FinLytics evaluation & integration checklist

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today — appreciate the candid discussion about accuracy and latency constraints. As promised, here’s a concise post-call recap and a proposed POC plan so we can align on scope, timeline, and owners.

Summary of needs (from the call)
- Inference latency target: 95th percentile < 300ms end-to-end for 512-token prompts
- Batch throughput: support burst to ~80 QPS during peak end-of-day processing windows
- Semantic similarity embeddings for search re-rank and near-dedup (embedding dimension preferred: 1024)
- Data privacy: VPC-only for production; POC can run in Redwood Dedicated but must not persist raw inputs

Proposed POC objectives (success criteria)
1) Functional: Live API integration that returns coherent generations for 6 canonical prompts and embeddings for 2,000 sample documents with <10% regression vs current baseline accuracy metrics
2) Performance: 95th pctl latency < 300ms and stable throughput at 50 QPS for 1-hour soak test
3) Cost signal: End-to-end inference cost estimate for expected monthly volume (est. 40M tokens) delivered in the POC report
4) Security/compliance: Audit log export enabled and demonstration of access controls (role-based)

POC scope & timeline (high level)
- Week 1 (Feb 15–19): Kickoff, account setup, share test data snapshots, baseline accuracy capture
- Week 2 (Feb 22–26): Integration (SDK + REST) + streaming tests; embedder rollout; first performance run
- Week 3 (Mar 1–5): Tuning (batching, cache profiles, quantized variant test), soak tests, and runbook handoff
- Week 4 (Mar 8–12): Final report, cost model, and decision meeting

Owners
- Redwood: Rafael (sales owner, decision coordinator), Aditya (solutions/infra lead), Marissa (customer success, adoption plan)
- FinLytics: Elena (trial lead), Michael (platform engineer)

Next steps (this week)
- FinLytics: Share 2k-doc sample and 6 canonical prompts (Elena) — target Feb 13 EOD
- Redwood: Send detailed integration checklist and attach success-criteria workbook (Rafael) — sent with this thread
- Schedule 60-minute kickoff engineering session for Feb 16 — propose 10:00 PT

Attachments: FinLytics_POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx (spreadsheet) and detailed integration steps attached as markdown.

Thanks Rafael — this is helpful. A couple quick clarifications before the kickoff: 

1) For latency targets: our 300ms bar is for synchronous inference in our customer-facing UI. For batch scoring jobs (offline), we can accept higher latency. Can you call out which endpoints you recommend for each pattern?

2) Data handling: we can share anonymized doc snapshots. Is the POC dedicated capacity or hosted? We prefer Dedicated for more representative performance but can accept hosted for the first two weeks.

3) Embeddings: we want vector dim ~=1024 and reproducible results between runs (seeded). Is that supported?

We’ll upload a 2k sample to the Drive link you included by EOD Friday. Also — Feb 16 at 10:00 PT works for the kickoff.

Subject: Re: POC: FinLytics evaluation & integration checklist

Great questions — answers below and I’ve expanded the integration checklist in the attachment.

1) Endpoint guidance- Synchronous UI calls: use the /v1/chat/stream endpoint (streaming) for progressive rendering and lowest perceived latency; we recommend the quantized 8-bit variant for UI paths to keep latency tight.- Batch scoring / offline: use /v1/embeddings for bulk vectorization (support for chunked upload + parallel workers). We’ll provide sample worker code in the SDK snippet.

2) POC capacity: We recommend Redwood Dedicated for the POC (mirrors production isolation) — we can stand up a small Dedicated pool for the trial. I’ll mark this as the default; if you need hosted for the first 3 days for quick proof-of-concept, we can do that as a fallback.

3) Embedding reproducibility: We support deterministic seeds for embeddings and will include the seed parameter in the SDK examples. Note that quantization can introduce small nondeterminism; we’ll include a non-quantized baseline run for exact reproducibility checks.

Integration checklist (high level)- Authentication: API keys for POC with scoped project permissions; will provide short-lived keys for infra testing.- SDKs: JavaScript + Python snippets for chat + embeddings included in the attachment.- Streaming: /v1/chat/stream for incremental tokens; sample consumer shows reconnect and resume logic.- Tool calling: We support function/tool call schemas. For your pipeline, recommend modeling the re-ranker as a callable tool invoked after generation.- Logging & audit: Export of request/response logs to your S3 (or secure bucket) for CSR.

I’ve attached the redwood_poc_integration_steps.md that includes code snippets and configuration values.

Next immediate actions:
- I’ll provision a Dedicated trial pool; Aditya will reach out with onboarding details (SSH for private infra if needed).
- Please confirm you uploaded the 2k sample by EOD Feb 13 so our team can ingest and run the baseline.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.
